port.description.json: A JSON value such as text, a number, a boolean, an array or an object. Binary data is not accepted. Settings and connections may specify a more precise type.
Choose a path on the selected peer: Choose a path on the selected peer
Only this peer's allowed file roots are: Only this peer's allowed file roots are shown. You can also type a new path directly.
Use new path without creating it: Use new path without creating it
The directory is unavailable or outside: The directory is unavailable or outside this peer's allowed file roots.
This folder is too large to browse furth: This folder is too large to browse further. Type the path directly.
Could not browse this peer. Check its co: Could not browse this peer. Check its connection and allowed file roots.
API key stored in this cluster: API key stored in this cluster
Select a saved key name or paste an API: Select a saved key name or paste an API key below to register it. The workflow stores only the name. Keys are shared within this cluster; no environment variable is implied.
Saving replaces this named key for futur: Saving replaces this named key for future executions in this cluster.
Save key and use its name: Save key and use its name
Saved key names could not be read. Check: Saved key names could not be read. Check the cluster connection.
Key storage was not confirmed. Check the: Key storage was not confirmed. Check the original operation before trying again.
Leave empty to listen continuously. This: Leave empty to listen continuously. This timer starts with this source and ends reception normally. Accepted work may finish; its per-item timeout is separate.
Enter a positive duration in millisecond: Enter a positive duration in milliseconds, or leave empty for continuous listening.
Per-item communication deadline in milli: Per-item communication deadline in milliseconds. 0 or null disables it. This does not limit how long a source listens; use Stop listening after in Execution for that.
This is an IPv4 address assigned to the: This is an IPv4 address assigned to the execution PC's selected network adapter. Outgoing requests use it as their source address; listeners bind here. The destination is configured separately.
Network adapter on the execution PC. Sel: Network adapter on the execution PC. Select the execution PC first, then choose its adapter and local IPv4 address.
A name registered in this cluster's secr: A name registered in this cluster's secret store, not an environment variable or the key itself. Select a saved key or register one here.
The peer that owns the source file. The: The peer that owns the source file. The execution PC is the destination. Select either peer explicitly before browsing its paths.
Leave empty for a unique transfer ID for: Leave empty for a unique transfer ID for each execution. Set an ID only to explicitly resume the same source and content.
Enable to transfer a directory and all i: Enable to transfer a directory and all its contents, including empty folders.
This node builds a description of a type: This node builds a description of a type, not a data value. For array, connect one type definition to Element type. For object, build named fields with Key/value nodes whose values are type definitions, then connect the result to Property types.
The selected type converts this text int: The selected type converts this text into a value. Auto reads valid JSON and treats other input as text. A connected type definition overrides the type selector.
Allow this value to be missing or null w: Allow this value to be missing or null when it is used as a field type.
Number of received items before normal c: Number of received items before normal completion. Unset (or 0 where allowed) keeps listening; this is separate from the per-item deadline.
Choose a type here or connect a Type def: Choose a type here or connect a Type definition node. Array describes its elements; object describes named fields.
Resulting type definition (passed to con: Resulting type definition (passed to connected inputs)
Choose ordered OSC types here, or connec: Choose ordered OSC types here, or connect a type definition or an array of types. Integer uses Int32 (i), explicit Int64 uses h, number uses Float64 (d); use OSC tags for explicit wire precision. Each argument gets its own port. Unset uses packets; an empty list means no arguments.
Select a peer in this cluster. Connect t: Select a peer in this cluster. Connect the output to Source peer for a peer file transfer.
Peer used to browse paths. Choose the sa: Peer used to browse paths. Choose the same peer as the consumer, or leave unset to use its execution PC.
An absolute path on the selected peer. B: An absolute path on the selected peer. Browse an existing path or type a new destination. The path alone does not change the execution PC.
node.value.peer.name: Peer selection
node.value.peer.description: Select a peer ID for settings such as the source peer of a file transfer. The transfer node runs on its destination PC.
node.value.file.name: File selection
node.value.file.description: Browse a file on the selected peer or enter a path, then connect it to a file setting. New paths are supported; execution PC selection and file transfer are separate.
node.value.directory.name: Directory selection
node.value.directory.description: Browse a directory on the selected peer or enter a path, then connect it to a file setting. New paths are supported; execution PC selection and file transfer are separate.
Select the source PC in this workflow's: Select the source PC in this workflow's cluster. Connect PC selection to the execution PC input to choose the destination.
